description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework with type‑safe routing, native HTTP/2+QUIC, and built‑in edge/serverless support – the Express‑style API you love, re‑engineered for 2026.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the surge in edge‑first and AI‑ready back‑ends by spotlighting built‑in HTTP/3 (QUIC) support, zero‑dependency footprint, and first‑class TypeScript typings. Position yantravese as the only framework that delivers Express‑style simplicity *and* native serverless/edge deployment without extra adapters, matching the 2026 developer demand for ultra‑low latency and AI‑integrated APIs.
download_hooks: Developers choose yantravese for its instant zero‑install start‑up and sub‑millisecond routing – ideal for high‑traffic edge functions.
Performance: native HTTP/2+QUIC, no runtime transpilation, and a lean core that outpaces Fastify in raw request‑per‑second benchmarks.
Developer experience: Type‑safe declarative routes, built‑in OpenAPI generation, and a single‑file API that works on Node, Bun, Deno, and Cloudflare Workers out of the box.
